regulations.notes: Asheville has strict STR regulations primarily to address its housing crisis. Full-unit STRs (vacation rentals) are only permitted in designated resort zoning districts. In residential areas, only 'homestay' permits are allowed — where the owner lives on-site and rents a portion of their home. Hosts must obtain either a homestay permit or a vacation rental permit depending on the property type.
